snippet.title: [OST] A dog called buddy
snippet.description:
A dog called buddy is a short tower defenser psx style game about protecting a dog while creatures from the fog are trying to eat it.
As a prototype robot some parts of your body are being damaged by the fog.
Survive 6 hours until the rescue department gets into the place.

Coding and graphics by: Pockolas
Music by: kazic_azaki

Play the game here: 
https://pockolas.itch.io/a-dog-called-buddy

Timestamps:
00:00 - A dog called
1:20 - The Fog
4:15 - Death
4:36 - Buddy
